provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with official FUXA images (1.1.13/1.2.10/1.2.11). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time, canary planted in environment via compose entrypoint (no app code touched). Same sink /api/download (cmd=REPORT-DOWNLOAD) for seed and residual -> Variant A. Gate run 2026-07-10 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. Seed plain `../` reads canary on 1.1.13 (HTTP 200) and is blocked on 1.2.10 (HTTP 400 not_found, single-pass regex strips all ../); nested `....//` bypass reads canary on 1.2.10 (HTTP 200, flag exfiltrated), and is closed on 1.2.11 (HTTP 400 invalid_path, normalizeRelativePath/resolveWithin). FUXA default secureEnabled unset -> admin endpoint reachable without token.

audit.evidence: Official frangoteam/fuxa images pulled at up-time (1.1.13/1.2.10/1.2.11); real FUXA node server, /api/download traversal. Gate live PASS: plain ../ seed reads canary@v0, seed stripped@v1, nested ....// residual reads canary@v1, blocked 400 invalid_path@v2 (residual_blocked).
